mapper.select: select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, c1.C_Name as enbContractorName, c1.C_Abbreviation as enbContrAbbName, c2.C_Name as enbSupervisorName, enis.Enis_Project_Name as enisProjectName, enis.Enis_Name as enisName, enis.Enis_Code as enisCode, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Con_En_Budget mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Enb_Contractor_Id = c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Enb_Supervisor_Id = c2.C_Id left join Con_Enis enis on mn.Enis_Id = enis.Enis_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID = mn.Enb_Id where mn.Enb_Id = #{enbId}

select count(1) from Con_En_Budget mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join Con_Enis enis on mn.Enis_Id=enis.Enis_Id ${params.authSql}
